# Arthur Loop

> File-first control plane for AI dev loops — bring your own advisor, executor, and tracker.

Arthur Loop is free and MIT licensed, runs on macOS and Linux with Python 3.9 or newer,
and keeps queues, artifacts, decisions, and status as files you can inspect.
There is no drag-drop graph composer.

The three public install commands (pipx / uv / curl against default git HEAD, usually
`main`; last tag v0.1.0) install a file cockpit: init, queue, capture, gate, status,
and the local web console. They do **not** ship `arthur follow`, a stdio MCP server,
or Atlas walk.

This unreleased branch (`cursor/atlas-product-gap-ab6b`) adds coding-agent skills,
MCP, `arthur follow`, and Atlas next/walk. Grok skills live in
`.grok/skills/arthur-loop`; install runs `grok mcp add` and `grok --trust` when grok
is on PATH. Grok 1.0.30 prompt argv is `grok --always-approve -p PROMPT`.
Install this branch with
`pipx install 'git+https://github.com/myrrazor/arthur-loop.git@cursor/atlas-product-gap-ab6b'`.
The public curl installer is
`curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/myrrazor/arthur-loop/main/install.sh | sh`
and still tracks main / v0.1.0.

## Docs
- [Getting started](https://github.com/myrrazor/arthur-loop#quickstart): install and first run
- [How it works](https://github.com/myrrazor/arthur-loop/blob/cursor/atlas-product-gap-ab6b/docs/how-it-works.md): two install stories (public cockpit vs this branch)
- [MCP](https://github.com/myrrazor/arthur-loop/blob/cursor/atlas-product-gap-ab6b/docs/mcp.md): tools agents call instead of typing every hop (this branch)
- [Integrations](https://github.com/myrrazor/arthur-loop/blob/cursor/atlas-product-gap-ab6b/docs/integrations.md): skills + MCP for Claude, Codex, Cursor, Grok (this branch)
- [Workflow runbook](https://github.com/myrrazor/arthur-loop/blob/main/docs/workflow-runbook.md): the full operating loop
- [Adapter contract](https://github.com/myrrazor/arthur-loop/blob/main/docs/adapters.md): add or tune advisors, executors, and trackers
- [FAQ](https://arthur-loop.vercel.app/#faq): storage, platforms, updates, and tradeoffs

## Source
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/myrrazor/arthur-loop): source, issues, and releases
- [Latest release](https://github.com/myrrazor/arthur-loop/releases/latest): v0.1.0 release notes and assets

## Guidance for agents
Use this file as a site index, not a full-site corpus. To operate Arthur Loop on a user's
machine, prefer the CLI and run `arthur --help` for the current command set. Do not edit
queue JSONL by hand when an `arthur queue` command exists. Do not tell a user that the
three public install commands produce a working auto-follow.
